nodes.description: Ownable.owner - privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor, used by onlyOwner checks and as ether transfer recipient.
Pausable.paused - global emergency stop flag gating whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers across exchange and token.
HorseyExchange.marketMakerFee - percentage fee (default 3) applied on top of listed price.
HorseyExchange.collectedFees - accrued protocol fees withdrawable by owner.
HorseyExchange.token - ERC721Basic interface to the RoyalStables NFT contract; external call target.
HorseyExchange.market - mapping tokenId => SaleData(price, owner) describing active listings.
HorseyExchange.userBarn - mapping owner => tokenId[] of tokens listed by that owner.
HorseyToken.stables - RoyalStablesInterface used for all horsey storage/mutation external calls.
HorseyToken.carrotsMultiplier - owner-controlled multiplier for carrots credited when burning a horsey.
HorseyToken.rarityMultiplier - owner-controlled multiplier influencing the randomness threshold in _feed.
HorseyToken.claimingFee - ether required by the costs modifier when claiming a special horsey.
HorseyToken.pendingFeedings - mapping address => FeedingData(blockNumber, horsey) tracking in-flight feeding.
HorseyToken.renamingCostsPerChar - per character price in wei for renaming a horsey.
HorseyPilot.jokerAddress - C-level role receiving the residual equity share.
HorseyPilot.knightAddress - C-level role receiving knightEquity share.
HorseyPilot.paladinAddress - C-level role receiving paladinEquity share.
HorseyPilot.voters - fixed address[3] of accounts allowed to vote on proposals.
HorseyPilot.exchangeAddress - deployed HorseyExchange address used in privileged calls.
HorseyPilot.tokenAddress - deployed HorseyToken address used in privileged calls.
HorseyPilot._cBalance - internal mapping of pending ether owed to each C-level role.
HorseyPilot.currentProposal - pending proposal struct (proposer, timestamp, parameter, methodId, yay, nay).
HorseyPilot.proposalInProgress - boolean lifecycle flag for the current proposal.
HorseyPilot.toBeDistributed - undistributed ether synced from child contracts.
HorseyPilot.cooldownStart - timestamp anchor used for the proposal cooldown window.
HorseyPilot.deployed - one-shot guard for deployChildren.
EthorseHelpers.all_horses - mutable bytes32[] of tracked coin symbols used in winner resolution.
EthorseHelpers._legitOwners - whitelist of betting controller owners accepted by _isWinnerOf.
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for ownership, role and refund decisions.
block.timestamp - miner-influenced time used for proposal lifetime, cooldown and vote windows.
token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tokenId) inside depositToExchange - external ERC721 call to a settable address.
token.transferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, tokenId) inside cancelSale - external ERC721 call executed before bookkeeping cleanup.
sale.owner.transfer(sale.price) inside purchaseToken - state-changing ether send to an attacker-controlled seller before market/userBarn cleanup.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value.sub(totalToPay)) inside purchaseToken - ether refund to caller.
token.transferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, tokenId) inside purchaseToken - NFT delivery via external call.
owner.transfer(collectedFees) inside HorseyExchange.withdraw - fee payout followed by collectedFees reset.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value.sub(renamingFee)) inside renameHorsey - overpayment refund to caller.
owner.transfer(address(this).balance) inside HorseyToken.withdraw - drains the whole token contract balance.
destination.transfer(balance) inside withdrawCeo - C-level payout before _cBalance is zeroed.
new HorseyExchange() / new HorseyToken(stablesAddress) inside deployChildren - contract creation and privileged setStables call.
_doProposal dispatches privileged calls (setRenamingCosts, setMarketFees, addLegitDevAddress, addHorseIndex, pause/unpause, setClaimingCosts, multipliers) to child contracts.
collectedFees += totalToPay - sale.price - raw unchecked arithmetic on fee accounting.
toBeDistributed.add(newBalance - prevBalance) inside syncFunds - raw subtraction on measured balances.
Equity split arithmetic in _updateDistribution (div/mul/add/sub on toBeDistributed and _cBalance).
blockhash(blockNumber) consumed in stopFeeding/_feed as randomness source - miner/blockhash manipulable.
HorseyExchange.setStables(address _token) - onlyOwner setter of the ERC721 address.
HorseyExchange.setMarketFees(uint256 fees) - onlyOwner fee setter.
HorseyExchange.getTokenPrice(uint256 tokenId) - view computing price plus fee.
HorseyExchange.depositToExchange - pulls user NFT into escrow and records SaleData.
HorseyExchange.cancelSale - returns NFT to original owner and clears market/barn entries.
HorseyExchange.purchaseToken - payable purchase paying the seller and delivering the NFT to the buyer.
HorseyExchange.withdraw - onlyOwner fee payout with balance assertion.
HorseyExchange._removeTokenFromBarn - internal array compaction of userBarn.
HorseyExchange._indexOf - internal linear scan returning index or -1.
HorseyExchange.getTokensOnSale - view returning userBarn[user].
HorseyToken.claim - payable race winner claim that mints a special horsey.
HorseyToken.renameHorsey - payable rename with refund of overpayment.
HorseyToken.freeForCarrots - burns an owned horsey and credits carrots.
HorseyToken.feed - starts a feeding, locking carrots and recording block.number.
HorseyToken.stopFeeding - resolves a pending feeding using blockhash randomness.
HorseyToken._feed - internal rarity roll and feedingCounter increment.
HorseyToken._generate_special_horsey - derives token id/dna and stores the horsey.
HorseyToken._increaseRarity - private tier increment and dna rarity mask application.
HorseyToken.setRarityMultiplier - onlyOwner randomness scaling setter.
HorseyToken.setCarrotsMultiplier - onlyOwner carrot reward setter.
HorseyToken.setRenamingCosts - onlyOwner rename price setter.
HorseyToken.setClaimingCosts - onlyOwner claim fee setter.
HorseyToken.addLegitDevAddress - onlyOwner whitelist extension for betting controllers.
HorseyToken.addHorseIndex - onlyOwner addition of a coin symbol.
HorseyToken.withdraw - onlyOwner full balance transfer.
HorseyToken.can_claim - view wrapper over _isWinnerOf.
HorseyToken.getCarrotCredits - view of caller carrot credits.
HorseyToken.getHorsey - view assembling horsey data and name.
HorseyToken.getOwnedTokens - view proxying stables.getOwnedTokens.
HorseyToken fallback - payable function that reverts.
HorseyPilot.deployChildren - one-shot deployment of exchange and token plus privileged setStables.
HorseyPilot.transferJokerOwnership - role handover guarded by msg.sender equality.
HorseyPilot.transferKnightOwnership - role handover guarded by msg.sender equality.
HorseyPilot.transferPaladinOwnership - role handover guarded by msg.sender equality.
HorseyPilot.withdrawCeo - C-level pending balance payout.
HorseyPilot.syncFunds - permissionless pull of child contract balances.
HorseyPilot.getNobleBalance - view of caller pending balance.
HorseyPilot.makeProposal - C-level proposal creation with cooldown gate.
HorseyPilot.voteOnProposal - voter casting yay/nay; threshold triggers execution.
HorseyPilot._moveBalance - internal pending balance migration on role transfer.
HorseyPilot._updateDistribution - internal equity split of toBeDistributed.
HorseyPilot._doProposal - internal dispatcher executing approved privileged calls.
Ownable.transferOwnership - onlyOwner owner reassignment.
Ownable.renounceOwnership - onlyOwner renounce to address(0).
Pausable.pause - onlyOwner sets paused=true.
Pausable.unpause - onlyOwner sets paused=false.
EthorseHelpers._isWinnerOf - internal race resolution trusting whitelisted controller and external race calls.
EthorseHelpers._addLegitOwner - internal whitelist write.
EthorseHelpers._addHorse - internal push to all_horses.

edges.reason: owner is read by onlyOwner and used as the ether transfer recipient in HorseyExchange.withdraw.
owner is the authorization subject and source event argument of transferOwnership.
owner is checked and set to address(0) by renounceOwnership.
paused gates purchaseToken via whenNotPaused.
paused gates feed via whenNotPaused.
pause writes paused=true after onlyOwner.
unpause writes paused=false after onlyOwner.
marketMakerFee directly scales the price returned by getTokenPrice.
setMarketFees overwrites marketMakerFee, restricted to onlyOwner.
collectedFees is transferred to owner and then reset to zero.
setStables assigns the external ERC721 address stored in token.
token.getApproved and token.transferFrom are invoked using the stored ERC721 reference.
token.transferFrom delivers the NFT to the buyer in purchaseToken.
cancelSale reads and deletes market[tokenId] SaleData.
purchaseToken reads and deletes market[tokenId] to pay the seller.
_removeTokenFromBarn mutates userBarn[barnAddress] storage array.
claim calls stables.storeHorsey through the stored interface.
feed reads stables.horseys and writes carrot credits via stables.
stopFeeding checks stables.ownerOf and mutates horsey state.
carrotsMultiplier scales feedingCounter to compute credited carrots.
rarityMultiplier scales the randomness threshold in _feed.
claimingFee enforces the payable amount via the costs modifier.
feed writes FeedingData into pendingFeedings[msg.sender].
stopFeeding reads and deletes pendingFeedings[msg.sender].
renamingCostsPerChar multiplied by name length determines the required payment.
jokerAddress participates in onlyCLevelAccess and receives distributed funds.
knightAddress participates in onlyCLevelAccess and receives distributed funds.
paladinAddress participates in onlyCLevelAccess and receives distributed funds.
voters array is the sole whitelist enforced by the onlyVoters modifier.
_doProposal invokes HorseyExchange(exchangeAddress) for fee and pause changes.
_doProposal invokes HorseyToken(tokenAddress) for renaming, claim and multiplier changes.
withdrawCeo reads _cBalance[msg.sender], transfers out, then zeroes the entry.
_updateDistribution credits _cBalance entries for the three roles.
voteOnProposal mutates currentProposal.yay/nay arrays.
_doProposal reads currentProposal.methodId and parameter to dispatch privileged calls.
makeProposal sets proposalInProgress and is gated by proposalAvailable.
toBeDistributed is split by div/mul/sub arithmetic in _updateDistribution.
cooldownStart anchors the cooledDown modifier check.
deployed guard is required to be false before deployChildren proceeds.
msg.sender is the NFT source and barn owner keyed in depositToExchange.
msg.sender is checked by notOriginalOwnerOf, receives the NFT and the overpayment refund.
msg.sender must satisfy can_claim and receives the minted special horsey.
msg.sender must be token owner and is the refund recipient in renameHorsey.
msg.sender ownership and pending feedings are checked in freeForCarrots.
msg.sender keys pendingFeedings and the carrot debit in feed.
msg.sender must match a C-level role and its _cBalance entry is paid out.
msg.sender must be C-level and becomes currentProposal.proposer.
msg.sender must be in voters and not have voted already.
block.timestamp initializes cooldownStart at deployment and on failed proposals.
block.timestamp drives proposalAvailable, cooledDown and proposal timestamp.
block.timestamp enforces the proposalLife voting window.
depositToExchange executes the ERC721 transferFrom external call.
cancelSale performs the external NFT transfer before clearing market and barn state.
purchaseToken sends ether to the seller before deleting the market entry and barn record.
purchaseToken refunds the overpayment to an untrusted caller.
purchaseToken delivers the NFT through an external ERC721 call.
purchaseToken updates collectedFees with raw addition/subtraction.
HorseyExchange.withdraw transfers collectedFees and only afterwards resets it.
renameHorsey transfers the overpayment back to msg.sender.
HorseyToken.withdraw forwards the entire balance to owner.
withdrawCeo transfers to the destination before zeroing _cBalance.
deployChildren creates both child contracts and calls setStables on the exchange.
syncFunds computes the delta of contract balances with raw subtraction.
_updateDistribution performs div/mul/sub/add equity arithmetic.
_doProposal fires a chain of privileged state-changing calls on both child contracts.
stopFeeding consumes blockhash(blockNumber) as the randomness seed.
seller ether transfer can re-enter purchaseToken before market[tokenId] is deleted.
buyer refund transfer can re-enter purchaseToken during the same transaction.
the ERC721 transferFrom call gives a malicious token contract execution control mid-function.
the settable ERC721 address is called during depositToExchange before market state is written.
the ERC721 transferFrom executes before cancelSale deletes market[tokenId].
owner transfer in HorseyExchange.withdraw can re-enter before collectedFees is zeroed.
the refund transfer in renameHorsey can re-enter the renaming flow.
the balance transfer in HorseyToken.withdraw can re-enter the withdrawal.
destination.transfer in withdrawCeo can re-enter before _cBalance[msg.sender] is cleared.
privileged child-contract calls in _doProposal hand control to external contracts mid-execution.
claim re-validates the caller through can_claim.
claim resolves the winning horse via _isWinnerOf.
claim mints the special horsey through _generate_special_horsey.
stopFeeding finalizes the feeding through _feed.
_feed conditionally calls _increaseRarity when the random roll succeeds.
_removeTokenFromBarn locates the element with _indexOf.
withdrawCeo triggers _updateDistribution when toBeDistributed is non-zero.
voteOnProposal executes _doProposal once the yay threshold is reached.
the user-supplied tokenId flows into the ERC721 transferFrom call in purchaseToken.
totalToPay bounds the refund amount computed with msg.value.sub.
the memory sale copy supplies the recipient and amount for the seller transfer.
renamingFee is subtracted from msg.value to compute the refund.
the blockHash parameter seeds keccak256 randomness in _feed.
randNum is compared against feedingCounter*rarityMultiplier to decide rarity.
the caller-supplied destination parameter is the recipient of the payout in withdrawCeo.
the local balance read from _cBalance determines the withdrawal amount.
prevBalance and newBalance are subtracted to compute the synced amount.
knightPayday feeds the _cBalance credit arithmetic in _updateDistribution.
jokerPayday is derived by subtracting the other paydays from toBeDistributed.
